plan.summary: BRO-5891: release five Billy Crystal 860 opening-night reviews (NY Post, Time Out, NY Theatre Guide, The Independent, People) wrongly excluded as non-reviews by a title-only content-verifier heuristic, and fix the Vulture critic name. NY Daily News stays excluded: it syndicates Chris Jones's Chicago Tribune review, already live.
steps: For each of the five files: set nonReviewManualClear, clear isNonReview and rejectionReason (isNonReviewReason is a write-guarded audit trail and stays)
